map.聚餐、合租、团购后常需平摊费用并加小费。填入总额、人数与小费比例，即可得出每人应: Splitting a bill after a group meal, shared flat or group buy usually means dividing the cost and adding a tip. Enter the total, the number of people and the tip percentage to get each person's share and the total tip, avoiding mistakes from working it out in your head.
map.人均分摊 = 总金额 ÷ 人数；含服务费时总金额 = 消费额 ×（1 + 服务费: Per-person share = total ÷ number of people; with a service charge, total = spend × (1 + service rate); for proportional splitting an individual's share = total × their spend ÷ total spend; adjustment = total − Σ amounts actually paid; after rounding to the cent, give the remainder to whoever has the largest decimal part, so that Σ shares equals the total exactly.
map.小费通常按税前或税后账单计算，本工具基于总额（含税前）乘以比例，符合多数餐厅习惯: Tips are usually calculated on the pre-tax or post-tax bill; this tool multiplies the total (pre-tax basis) by the percentage, which matches most restaurants' practice; some overseas venues use the pre-tax bill, so adjust to local rules.
map.人数必须为正整数；小数人数无实际意义，工具自动取整。: The number of people must be a positive integer; a fractional count is meaningless, so the tool rounds it.
map.如需按不同消费金额分账（有人多点），请用逐项 AA，本工具仅支持均摊。: To split by differing amounts (when some people order more), use item-by-item splitting; this tool only splits evenly.
map.聚餐、旅行等场景下，按人头或按比例公平分摊总费用。: At meals out, on trips and in similar situations, share the total fairly per person or proportionally.
map.含小费、税费或服务费时，将附加费一并分摊到每人。: When a tip, tax or service charge applies, spread the extra across everyone too.
map.有人享受折扣或免单时，灵活调整各人应付金额。: When someone gets a discount or eats free, adjust each person's share flexibly.
map.餐费 300 元、小费 30 元、折扣 −20 元，合计 310 元由 3 人均: A meal costs 300 CNY with a 30 CNY tip and a 20 CNY discount, so 310 CNY split three ways is about 103.33 CNY each; if one person eats free, the remaining two pay 155 CNY each.
map.按比例分摊和按人头分摊有何不同？: How does proportional splitting differ from splitting per person?
map.按人头是等额均分，适合消费共享；按比例可按各自点单金额或约定权重分摊，更公平但对: Per-person splitting divides equally and suits shared consumption; proportional splitting uses each person's order amount or an agreed weight, which is fairer but harder to reconcile.
map.折扣和税费怎么处理？: How are discounts and taxes handled?
map.先算应付总额（含税费、加减折扣），再按选定方式分摊；小费通常按比例加在每人份额上: Work out the total payable first (including tax and taking discounts into account), then split by the chosen method; the tip is normally added proportionally to each share so nobody is overcharged.
